context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 217 adds 4 keyless competitor-parity features (Batch 4 of 30 P0 gaps): (1) Spaces Multi-Product Inventory at /api/spaces/* and /api/space-bookings/* with 8 kinds (parking, ev_charger, meeting_room, bicycle, locker, cabana, kayak, other), daily/hourly pricing via unit_minutes, capacity-based overlap check (409 when full), folio posting on charge_to=room. (2) Multi-Currency at /api/currency/* with 20 default rates vs GBP, property-level overrides in fx_rates collection, two-hop conversion via GBP. (3) Multi-Property Roll-up at /api/multi-property/rollup with chain-wide KPIs (revenue, bookings, ADR, RevPAR, occupancy, no-shows, complaints), properties sorted by revenue desc. (4) BEO PDF at /api/beo/{event_id}/sheet returns printable HTML A4 sheet (404 if no event). Frontend panels: SpacesPanel (kind dropdown 8 options, capacity & rate inputs, book modal), MultiPropertyRollupPanel (5 KPI tiles + per-property table, days filter 7/14/30/60/90), CurrencyPanel (conversion test row + 20 currency overrides + save button). Sidebar buttons: spaces-btn, multi-rollup-btn, currency-btn. Fixed missing phosphor-icons imports (SquaresFour, CurrencyDollar).
